model: TriMotion (official weights; isolated inference-only latent-anchor adapter)
mode: V2V + actual Stage2 endpoint image + identity relative camera
timing_note: 81 source frames at25fps generated as81 frames at30fps; motion order, not exact source duration, can be compared
sampling_variant: Custom inference-only: after each official FlowMatchScheduler step, pin output first VAE time latent to appropriately noised VAE(actual Stage2 endpoint); preserve source-action latents and all other generated latents. No model-weight changes, no decoded-frame replacement.

native_first_to_stage2_endpoint.method: Decode native MP4 frame0 and bicubic-resize true Stage2 endpoint PNG to 672x384, RGB pixel comparison

component_review.from_actual_stage2_endpoint: conditioned, first latent pinned; native frame0 closely matches endpoint but codec/VAE difference remains
component_review.source_action_order: sampled source and native at frames 0/20/40/60/80; corresponding major poses appear in the same order; full action fidelity needs manual review
component_review.camera_static: relative identity camera supplied; output camera constancy needs manual review
component_review.absolute_target_pose: not calibrated from Stage2 image; unsupported by this input
